fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow -run TestIncludeHandbackTarget passes: a workflow including one whose step has on.fail = "handback:conduct" parses with that included step's on.fail = "handback:<workflow>/conduct", and the included conduct step present as <workflow>/conduct; an included handback:nosuch is refused with an error naming nosuch and the included workflow; done and failed targets still map as today. go test -trimpath ./internal/run -run TestHandbackIncluded passes: a run on such an including workflow whose included step fails hands back to <workflow>/conduct and continues from it. Touches internal/workflow/include.go, internal/workflow/include_test.go and internal/run/include_test.go.
fields.statement: A handback:<step> route inside an included workflow keeps pointing at the included step: when a workflow step includes another, include.go's inlined.outer maps handback:<step> to handback:<workflow>/<step> (as it prefixes a plain step target), instead of prefixing the whole target into <workflow>/handback:<step>; a handback naming a step the included workflow does not have is refused at parse, naming the step and the workflow.
